specs.dimensions_axes: L = along the extrusion/cable axis incl. the two end mounting flanges (extruded body alone 87), W = across the fins (50.7), H = mounting face to top (33.8 body; 35 incl. 1 mm flange offset). Product text says 85 x 50.7 x 33.8; the drawing on the same page shows an 87 mm body
specs.dimensions_mm_basis: product page dimension drawing (flipsky.net 75100 'Detail size' image)
specs.mass_note: Not published. 600 g is the Shopify shipping weight (box, USB cable, hall adapter, manual). 230 g estimated from the 87 x 50.7 x 33.8 aluminium extrusion, end plates/flanges, power PCB and ~15 cm 12 AWG leads; weigh one.

mounting.type: two flat flange plates, one under each end of the extrusion, flush with the bottom face
mounting.pattern_note: 100 mm along L (4 mm from each flange end; flange-to-flange 108), 27 mm across (flange plate 35 wide, centred on the body)
mounting.hole_diameter_note: drawing label '5,8' beside the holes (reads as clearance for M5); a 4.2 mm wide open slot also sits on the centreline of each flange (usable for M4)
mounting.fastener: M5 (or M4 through the centre slots)

specs.cable_exits: Everything leaves ONE end face through a round grommet: battery + / - (12 AWG, red/black), 3 motor phases (12 AWG, blue/green/yellow, bare ends), and fly-lead pigtails: USB-C (female, on a lead), HALL 6-pin, COMM 7-pin (UART/ADC), PPM 3-pin, UART2 8-pin, CAN 2-pin (CANL/CANH). The opposite end face is blank.
specs.orientation_cooling: The finned aluminium case is the heatsink; no fan. A power/LED button is on the top face, 48 mm from one end. Bolt the flat bottom to a metal plate or leave the fins in airflow for 100 A continuous; any orientation. Leave >=60 mm beyond the cable end for the 12 AWG bend and pigtails (estimate).
specs.length_height_note: length_mm/height_mm are the overall envelope incl. end flanges (body 87 x 50.7 x 33.8; product text says 85 mm)

cad.note: Flipsky publishes no STEP; model from the product-page dimension drawing.

notes: Phase filter must be off on firmware >=5.3 or the ESC can be damaged. Mass not published. Dimensions and 100 x 27 mm four-hole flange pattern from the product-page drawing; all wiring exits one end. Mass is an estimate (not published). Not verified (2026-10-26): mass (estimate 230 g; 600 g is shipping weight); mounting hole diameter 5.8 read from a low-resolution drawing; exact overall height 33.8 vs 35 (flange offset); grommet diameter on the cable end.
